Administration in children. UK licensed product informa- tion does not recommend the use of linezolid in children and ad- olescents below 18 years of age. However, the BNFC suggests the following doses of linezolid in the treatment of pneumonia or complicated skin and soft-tissue infections, given orally or by in- travenous infusion over 30 to 120 minutes: • neonates up to 7 days old: 10 mg/kg every 12 hours, increas- ing to every 8 hours if response is poor • 7 days to 12 years of age: 10 mg/kg (to a maximum of 600 mg) every 8 hours
